name: Zen Space Color Sync
author: Tangent
description: Pushes the active space's accent colour into web pages as the --zen-space-color CSS variable, so in-page UI (like the Tangent Reader overlay) can theme itself to match your browser chrome.

zen-space-color-bridge.uc.mjs.description: Mirrors --zen-primary-color into the content document per active space.
